seo.description: Build your MVP with Agencia IDP, an MVP development company in Colombia. We validate your idea in weeks with minimal risk and investment, starting at USD 1,000.

sections[2].blocks[2].html: At Agencia IDP we specialize in building minimum viable products (MVPs) that help founders, startups and companies validate business ideas quickly, affordably and with room to scale.
sections[3].blocks[1].html: A Minimum Viable Product (MVP) is the fastest and most effective way to take your idea to market without overspending. You build only what is essential to solve a real problem, test it with users and learn before investing more.
